headlines.title: Judge orders White House to restore access for CNN, MS NOW and Politico
headlines.description: A federal judge has ordered the White House to immediately restore access for CNN, MS NOW, and Politico. NBC News’ Nikki Battiste and Gary Grumbach report on the judge’s ruling.

headlines.title: U.S. says China trade truce extended by 2 months
headlines.description: The agreement extends the suspension of some tariffs as Chinese President Xi Jinping arrives in Washington for a state visit.

headlines.title: Trump hosts China’s leader at high-stakes summit
headlines.description: President Trump is hosting China’s leader Xi Jinping for a high-stakes summit in Washington. NBC News’ Gabe Gutierrez reports.

headlines.title: Yemen says it asked Trump for U.S. military support in fight against Houthis
headlines.description: A senior official said Yemen is seeking help as the Iranian-backed rebels tighten their grip on its Red Sea coast, threatening to further disrupt global energy shipments.

headlines.title: Iranian president claims they are 'victims of terrorism' in United Nations speech
headlines.description: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian used his address to the United Nations to draw attention to leaders, scientists and civilians who had been killed and accused the United States of "terrorism." NBC News' Matt Bradley reports on the leader's remarks and the ongoing conflict overseas.

headlines.title: Trump’s FDA pick to face scrutiny over abortion pill access at confirmation hearing
headlines.description: Dr. Heidi Overton is also expected to address President Donald Trump’s claim labeling the measles vaccine “lethal.”

headlines.title: Navy says eight sailors attempted suicide across U.S.S. Abraham Lincoln strike group
headlines.description: The Navy has stated in a letter that eight people attempted suicide across the U.S.S. Lincoln strike group. The information was released after a lawmaker inquired into the numbers following a particularly difficult deployment for the strike group.

headlines.title: These young quarterbacks were supposed to break out. Now they’re hurt.
headlines.description: The New York Giants’ Jaxson Dart on Monday became the latest upstart QB to be sidelined with an injury, joining the Bears’ Caleb Williams and the Commanders’ Jayden Daniels as signal callers who had to leave the field early in Week 2.

headlines.title: Russia forced a Ukrainian soldier to make a propaganda video. His village refused to bury him.
headlines.description: Russia has coerced thousands of Ukrainian prisoners to denounce their leaders and country in propaganda videos. The consequences can follow them home.

headlines.title: Trump touts peace settlements he has brokered in remarks to United Nations
headlines.description: President Trump said it had been a "great honor" to help broker multiple peace deals between nations during his address to the United Nations General Assembly. The president also touted the praise and thanks he had received from the leaders involved in the deals.

headlines.title: Trump’s FDA pick to face scrutiny over abortion pill access at confirmation hearing
headlines.description: Dr. Heidi Overton is also expected to address President Donald Trump’s claim labeling the measles vaccine “lethal.”

headlines.title: Judge orders White House to restore access for CNN, MS NOW and Politico
headlines.description: A federal judge ordered early Thursday that the White House immediately restore access for CNN, MS NOW and Politico, saying that President Donald Trump’s directive barring the three news outlets was most likely unconstitutional.
